questions.question: Under what condition can two matrices A and B be multiplied together to form the product AB?
options: The number of columns in A equals the number of rows in B.
The number of rows in A equals the number of columns in B.
The number of columns in A equals the number of columns in B.
The matrices A and B have identical dimensions.
questions.answer: The number of columns in A equals the number of rows in B.

questions.question: If matrix A is a 2 x 3 matrix and matrix B is a 2 x 2 matrix, which of the following statements is true regarding matrix multiplication?
options: BA is defined, but AB is not defined.
AB is defined, but BA is not defined.
Both AB and BA are defined.
Neither AB nor BA is defined.
questions.answer: BA is defined, but AB is not defined.

questions.question: If A is an m x n matrix and B is an n x p matrix, what is the size of the product matrix C = AB, and how is its (i, j)th entry cij calculated?
options: C is an m x p matrix, and cij is the product of the ith row of A and the jth column of B.
C is an n x n matrix, and cij is the product of the ith column of A and the jth row of B.
C is an m x p matrix, and cij is the product of the jth row of A and the ith column of B.
C is a p x m matrix, and cij is the product of the ith row of A and the jth column of B.
questions.answer: C is an m x p matrix, and cij is the product of the ith row of A and the jth column of B.
